notes.title: Version 2.0
notes.content:
And here is the final one of these Version 2.0 updates for the Academy series! Woo!

Please note that since this update overhauls many of the game's maps, it may have incompatibility issues with some existing save files. This is more likely to happen with smaller interior maps. If this affects you, then you can roll back to the previous version by right-clicking on the game in your Steam library and then clicking Properties. From the "Betas" tab, select "previous - Version 1.0".

Here are the changes in this version:
[list]
[*] Dozens of new character faces and expressions, for major and minor characters alike!
[*] A new interface featuring graphics for the various interactions with the environment! Look at it! Take it! Use it! Talk to it!
[*] Larger graphics! Some players had complained that the characters and objects in the environment were too small, so the size of the character sprites and tiles have been increased by 50%.
[*] Lots of little fixes and improvements! The stars now move when you're on a traveling spaceship. When you save your game, it will now show what stage of the story you were at. There's also an exit button on the title screen - especially useful for those who prefer playing in full-screen mode. There's also a fix for a rare graphics rendering bug in the engine which could cause random freezes.
[/list]

As usual, please let me know if you have any issues with the game following this update.

notes.title: Quick Update
notes.content:
Today's update is mainly just to bring Greenworks (which we use to enable Steam achievements) up to the latest version.It seems to be working fine, but please do let us know if you experience any problems with achievements or launch issues.

Also fixed a few bugs that players have reported:

[list][*] Removed invisible obstacles outside Warden HQ.
[*] You can no longer walk around on the walls of the shack during the final sequence.
[*] Fixed a bug involving the hatch on Quicksilver.
[*] Some minor dialogue corrections.
[/list]
